title: EthnoLens record
description: One extracted plant mention, linked to the passage it came from. Every key is always present; unknown values are null. Changes to this file are announced to the whole team before they are made.

historical_name.description: Plant name exactly as written in the passage, historical spelling preserved.

local_name.description: Albanian local name from a documented source (e.g. Mustafa et al. 2012), never invented.

candidate_scientific_name.description: Scientific name with author as returned by GBIF, e.g. "Salvia officinalis L.". A candidate, not a confirmed identification.

plant_part.description: Lowercase English singular: leaf, root, seed, flower, bark, fruit, whole plant, ...

preparation.description: Preparation method as stated in the passage.

described_use.description: Use as described in the passage, quoted rather than turned into a medical claim.

other_ingredients.description: Other ingredients named in the same recipe.

source.description: Citation of the document, e.g. "MS Add. 9308".

passage.description: Exact transcribed or OCR text of the passage.

span.description: [start, end) character offsets of historical_name in passage. null when the name is not found verbatim.

language.description: Language of the source, e.g. "Middle English", "Latin".

period.description: Date or period of the source, e.g. "c. 1400".

evidence.description: Whether each value is stated in the source or inferred by the AI/a reference.

extraction_confidence.description: Confidence in the extraction. Lowered when the name is not found verbatim.

mapping_confidence.description: GBIF match: EXACT with confidence >= 90 -> high; FUZZY -> medium; otherwise candidate. null when there is no scientific name.
